info.title: SportsBook
info.description: The sportsbook API for the mobile app. Log in with `POST /auth/login` (or finish signing up with `POST /auth/register/verify`) and send the token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens last 90 days per device. Money is in cents (`*_cents`) except request amounts, which are whole shillings. Times are ISO 8601 in UTC.

get.description: Includes the wallet balance and what the account can do right now (bet, deposit, withdraw).

put.description: What to do when a price moves between adding a pick and placing the bet. Remembered for the next slip.

post.description: Checks the details and texts a code to the phone. The account is created by verify once the code matches.

phone.description: The number the code was sent to, normalized to 2547XXXXXXXX. Send it back with the code.

message.const: We have sent a code to your phone.

Returns an API token for this device. A player with two-factor authentication on must also send `code`: the

response is a 422 with an error on `code`.
Answers the same whether or not the number has an account; only numbers with an account get an SMS.

Checks each pick against the current price and returns the combined odds and the possible win for `stake`.
Send the picks again whenever they change; prices sent by the app are never trusted. A line whose price moved
has status `price_changed` and appears in `changed_prices` with its current price. Only the first pick per
match counts.

price.description: The price now, or null when the selection cannot be bet on.

total_odds.description: Combined odds of the lines that can be bet on, to two decimals.

stake_errors.description: Why the stake cannot be used, if it cannot.

possible_win_cents.description: Possible win in cents, capped at the maximum payout.

changed_prices.description: Selection id => current price, for each line whose price moved. @var array<string, string>

post.description:
Keeps only the selections open for betting now, one per match. The code expires when the first of those
matches kicks off. Limited to 10 a minute.
post.summary: Share a slip as a booking code

selection_ids.description: The selections saved on the code. @var list<int>

get.description:
Returns picks ready to send to the slip quote, at today's prices. Selections that can no longer be bet on
are left out and described in `unavailable`. Limited to 30 a minute.

unavailable.description: The saved selections that can no longer be bet on, described for the player.

get.description:
Newest first, 20 a page. Filter with `status=open` or `status=settled` (anything no longer open);
leave it out for all bets.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description:
One pick per match; more than one pick makes a multibet. Prices are checked again here: what happens when one
moved depends on `odds_change_policy` (the account's setting when left out). `slip_key` is any unique string
per slip, up to 64 characters: sending the same slip again returns the bet already placed with a 200 instead
of placing a second one.

A refused bet is a 422 with a `reason` the app can act on: `not-allowed`, `empty-slip`, `unavailable`,
`price-changed`, `duplicate-match`, `stake` or `insufficient-funds`.

422.description: The slip is invalid (`errors`) or the bet was refused (`reason`).

get.description: Found by its reference, the Bet ID shown to the player. Another player's bet is not found.

The sports with at least one competition on offer, each with its competitions and how many upcoming matches
they have. Same as the site's sidebar.

The same lists as the home page tabs, or one competition's matches. Each match carries the one market chosen
with `market` (1X2 by default) and a count of all its markets.
Kicked off and not yet finished. Betting on them is closed, so no markets are included.
Upcoming matches whose team or competition name contains `q`.

Markets are grouped into the same tabs as the match page: main, goals, correct score and half time. Empty
tabs are left out.
get.summary: A match with all its markets

get.description:
The open jackpot with its matches in kick-off order and its prize tiers. Each tier's pool is shared equally by
every entry with exactly that many right; a void match counts as right for everyone. Entries close at
`closes_at`, when the first match kicks off. A 404 means no jackpot is open.

post.description:
One pick (`1`, `X` or `2`) for every match, by the match `id` from the jackpot. The entry price leaves the
wallet. `entry_key` is any unique string per entry, up to 64 characters: sending the same entry again returns
the entry already made with a 200 instead of charging twice. A player may enter the same jackpot more than once.

A refused entry is a 422 with a `reason` the app can act on: `not-allowed`, `closed`, `picks` or
`insufficient-funds`.

422.description: The request is invalid (`errors`) or the entry was refused (`reason`).

get.description: Newest first, 20 a page, each with its picks and how they did.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

get.description:
One entry per period (daily, weekly, monthly), with `amount_cents` null where no limit is set, and how much
the limits still allow right now.

allowance_cents.description: Cents the limits still allow, or null when no limit is set.

raise_delay_hours.description: Hours a raise or removal waits before it applies. Cuts apply at once.

put.description:
`amount` in whole shillings, or null to remove the limit. Lowering a limit applies at once; raising or
removing one waits (see `pending_from`).

post.description:
Stops deposits and betting until the break ends; withdrawals still work. A break cannot be cancelled or
shortened, only made longer. `duration` is `24h`, `7d` or `30d` for a cool-off and `6m`, `1y` or `5y` for a
self-exclusion. The player's password confirms it.

get.description:
Balance, what the player's deposit limits still allow, the deposit and withdrawal bounds (in whole shillings)
and, when M-Pesa Paybill is set up, the numbers to pay from the M-Pesa menu.

deposit_allowance_cents.description: Cents the deposit limits still allow, or null when no limit is set.

withdrawal_approval_threshold.description: Withdrawals of this many shillings or more wait for approval.

paybill.description: The numbers to pay from the M-Pesa menu, or null when Paybill is not set up.

get.description: Every movement of money, newest first, 20 a page.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description:
Sends an M-Pesa payment prompt to the player's phone for `amount` whole shillings. The deposit starts pending:
poll it every few seconds until `is_pending` is false. Refused when the account cannot deposit, the amount is
out of bounds or over a deposit limit.

get.description: Another player's deposit is not found.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description:
Pays `amount` whole shillings to the player's M-Pesa number. The money leaves the balance at once. Amounts at
or above the approval threshold wait for review (status `awaiting-approval`) before they are paid.

DepositLimitPeriod.description: Deposit limits count rolling windows (decision 28): the last 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days, never calendar periods, so depositing either side of midnight cannot double a limit.
DepositLimitPeriod.title: DepositLimitPeriod

EnterJackpotRequest.description:
A jackpot entry: one pick per match. entry_key is generated once per entry by the app, so sending the same entry
twice charges once. Whether every match has a valid pick is checked when the entry is made.
EnterJackpotRequest.title: EnterJackpotRequest

ExclusionType.description: A break a player takes from betting. While it lasts they can log in and withdraw, but not deposit or bet. It can be extended but never shortened.
ExclusionType.title: ExclusionType

ForgotPasswordRequest.description: The number to text a password reset code to.
ForgotPasswordRequest.title: ForgotPasswordRequest

picks.description: In match order. `is_right` is null until the match has a result; a void match is right.

LoginRequest.description: Phone and password, plus an authenticator or recovery code when two-factor authentication is on.
LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest

OddsChangePolicy.description: Which price changes a player accepts between adding picks and placing the bet. The bet is always placed at the current prices; the policy only decides whether a change stops it.
OddsChangePolicy.title: OddsChangePolicy

PlaceBetRequest.description: A bet slip to place. slip_key is generated once per slip by the app, so sending the same slip twice places it once.
PlaceBetRequest.title: PlaceBetRequest

QuoteSlipRequest.description: Bet slip picks with the prices the player saw, and an optional stake in whole shillings.
QuoteSlipRequest.title: QuoteSlipRequest

ResendRegistrationCodeRequest.description: A number that has started signing up.
ResendRegistrationCodeRequest.title: ResendRegistrationCodeRequest

ResetPasswordRequest.description: The reset code and the new password. ResetPassword checks the code and password strength.
ResetPasswordRequest.title: ResetPasswordRequest

StartRegistrationRequest.description: Sign-up details. RegisterPlayer checks the number, password strength and age.
StartRegistrationRequest.title: StartRegistrationRequest

StoreBookingCodeRequest.description: The selections to save as a booking code.
StoreBookingCodeRequest.title: StoreBookingCodeRequest

StoreDepositRequest.description: A deposit amount in whole shillings. StartDeposit checks the amount against the deposit limits.
StoreDepositRequest.title: StoreDepositRequest

StoreExclusionRequest.description: A break from betting, confirmed with the player's password.
StoreExclusionRequest.title: StoreExclusionRequest

StoreWithdrawalRequest.description: A withdrawal amount in whole shillings. RequestWithdrawal checks the amount and balance.
StoreWithdrawalRequest.title: StoreWithdrawalRequest

UpdateDepositLimitRequest.description: A new deposit limit in whole shillings, or null to remove it.
UpdateDepositLimitRequest.title: UpdateDepositLimitRequest

UpdateOddsPolicyRequest.description: Which odds changes the player accepts when placing a bet.
UpdateOddsPolicyRequest.title: UpdateOddsPolicyRequest

VerifyRegistrationRequest.description: The SMS code that finishes a sign-up, and a name for the device the token is for.
VerifyRegistrationRequest.title: VerifyRegistrationRequest

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
